panel.title: Compatibility score
panel.errorTitle: Unable to load the compatibility score.
panel.notValidatedTitle: Validate your profile to see your score
panel.notValidatedBody: Your compatibility score will be computed as soon as your profile is completed and validated. Jobs remain browsable in the meantime.
panel.groupAria: Compatibility {score} out of 100. Confidence {confidence} out of 100.
panel.scoreHelp: the quality of the match, computed only on the known criteria.
panel.confidenceHelp: the share of information actually available for this calculation.
panel.helpToggle: What do these two numbers mean?
panel.helpText: Two numbers, two questions. Compatibility answers: “does what is known match your profile?”. Confidence answers: “how much do we really know about this job and your profile?”. A high score with low confidence rests on little information: the missing elements are listed under “Not specified”.
panel.lowDataBody: less than 40% of the criteria are known for this job. The score of {score} is provided as an indication only.

blocking.title: Blocking criteria
blocking.transparency: This job remains displayed for transparency. A blocking criterion does not cancel the score: it flags an incompatibility with your requirements. Adjustable in your preferences.

unknown.title: Not specified
unknown.note: Unknown data is never replaced by an estimate: it lowers the confidence index, not the score.
unknown.profileFallback: {label}: missing from your profile — complete your profile to evaluate this criterion.
unknown.uncertainFallback: {label}: information extracted from the job is uncertain — check the original posting.

explanation.title: Score explanation
explanation.disclaimer: Rephrasing generated from the facts above.
explanation.failed: The rephrasing is temporarily unavailable. The elements above remain accurate and complete.
explanation.quota: Generation limit reached ({hourly} per hour, {daily} per day). Next generation possible at {time}. Your existing drafts remain accessible.
